name: Mixx-DJ-MCP
description: Control Mixxx open-source DJ software through natural language. Full deck control, library management, effects, mixer, AI transitions, stem separation, vinyl control, audio analysis, set recording, DJ analytics, and autonomous AI mixing.
short_description: AI-powered Mixxx DJ controller with autonomous mixing
author: sandraschi

tools.name: mixx_deck
tools.description: Full deck control: play, stop, cue, loop, sync, hot cues, scratch, seek, beatjump, beatloop, rate, pregain, filter high/mid/low, quantize, keylock, load track, eject, video

tools.name: mixx_library
tools.description: Library search, crate/playlist browse, track info, filter by BPM/genre/key

tools.name: mixx_effects
tools.description: Effect chain management, enable/disable effects, parameter control, quick effect presets

tools.name: mixx_mixer
tools.description: Crossfader, per-channel EQ (high/mid/low), gain, volume, headphone cue, talkover, mic

tools.name: mixx_stems
tools.description: Stem separation via Demucs, sampler loading, stem-aware mixing

tools.name: mixx_transition
tools.description: AI-powered transitions between decks: suggest, apply, auto-crossfader

tools.name: mixx_vinyl
tools.description: Vinyl control calibration, scratch, deck mode switching

tools.name: mixx_crate
tools.description: LLM-generated smart crates by BPM, key, genre, energy

tools.name: mixx_skin
tools.description: Skin management: list, apply, preview Mixxx skins

tools.name: mixx_daw
tools.description: DAW export: render stems, mixdown, cue points

tools.name: mixx_set
tools.description: AI set sequencer: plan BPM progression and energy curve

tools.name: mixx_analyze
tools.description: Audio analysis via librosa: BPM, key (Krumhansl-Schmuckler), energy, cue points

tools.name: mixx_recording
tools.description: Record, replay, and export DJ sets as OSC command streams

tools.name: mixx_history
tools.description: DJ analytics: play history, transition log, style profile, track suggestions

tools.name: mixx_ai_set
tools.description: AI Autonomous Mix Agent: plan sets, suggest next track, perform transitions, review

tools.name: show_deck_status_card
tools.description: Prefab UI card with live deck KPIs

tools.name: show_mixer_status_card
tools.description: Prefab UI card with mixer status

tools.name: show_library_status_card
tools.description: Prefab UI card with library status
